analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 43.0 exiting oversold but still in neutral range. MACD histogram worsened from 0.0614 to -0.1171, maintaining a dead cross. Volume ratio at 0.87, indicating subdued activity. ADX at 41.2 shows a clear trend, but -DI (32.1) is above +DI (18.1), suggesting a persistent downtrend. Weekly SMA20 is at -5.02%. Overall, lack of directional momentum and continued weak trend warrant a wait-and-see approach.
